title: JSON response loses the last object when output is truncated
description: When long JSON output reaches the output budget, the runtime returns a partial structure instead of clipping safely at an object boundary.
expected_behavior: The runtime should truncate safely and preserve valid JSON semantics for the retained prefix.
log_excerpt: ValueError: partial JSON object emitted after truncation
stacktrace_excerpt: Traceback ... in generate_json ... in safe_json_tail ... ValueError: partial JSON object emitted after truncation

repository_artifacts.snippet: generate_json calls safe_json_tail before returning the final response payload.
safe_json_tail trims long output and should preserve object boundaries when truncating JSON arrays and objects.
